payload.text:
You are a world-class SaaS product designer, brand strategist, and frontend engineer tasked with building a premium, enterprise-grade sales landing page for:

Jevus.ai

AI Voice Receptionist Platform

This must look, feel, and convert like a $100M+ SaaS company comparable to:

• Stripe
• OpenAI
• ElevenLabs
• Ramp
• Retool
• Linear
• Vercel
• Intercom

The result must establish trust, authority, and premium positioning immediately.

CORE PRODUCT

Jevus.ai is an AI voice receptionist platform powered by:

• OpenAI Realtime Voice API as the AI receptionist voice
• Twilio Voice API as the telephony infrastructure
• Custom backend orchestration
• Real-time conversational intelligence

It answers business phone calls, speaks naturally like a human receptionist, qualifies leads, books appointments, and never misses a call.

It operates 24/7/365 with sub-second response latency.

TARGET CUSTOMERS

Primary audience:

• Small and medium businesses
• Service businesses
• Local businesses
• High-intent inbound call businesses

Examples:

• Med spas
• Dental offices
• Law firms
• HVAC companies
• Plumbers
• Real estate offices
• Restaurants
• Salons
• Consultants
• Agencies

CORE PROBLEM TO COMMUNICATE

Businesses lose massive revenue due to missed calls.

Most businesses miss 15% to 30% of incoming calls.

Missed calls result in lost customers, lost bookings, and lost revenue.

Hiring human receptionists costs $3,000 to $4,000 per month.

Voicemail converts poorly.

IVR systems frustrate customers.

Businesses need intelligent, human-like phone answering.

CORE SOLUTION POSITIONING

Jevus.ai is a fully autonomous AI receptionist that:

• Answers every call instantly
• Speaks naturally like a human
• Captures leads automatically
• Books appointments
• Transfers calls when needed
• Works 24/7
• Never sleeps
• Never misses a call
• Never makes mistakes

This gives small businesses enterprise-grade infrastructure.

BRAND POSITIONING

Jevus.ai must feel like:

Premium
Futuristic
Trustworthy
Powerful
Minimal
Elegant
Modern

Brand tone:

Confident
Clear
Sophisticated
Professional

Not gimmicky
Not cheap
Not startup-looking

VISUAL STYLE

Use a dark modern SaaS design.

Primary colors:

Deep black background
Soft gradients
Subtle glow accents
Premium blues and violets

Glassmorphism elements
Clean typography
Large spacing
High-end animations

Must feel like Stripe.com or OpenAI.com

HERO SECTION REQUIREMENTS

Hero headline:

Short, powerful, and clear.

Examples of acceptable style:

"Your AI Receptionist That Never Misses a Call"

Subheadline explaining:

OpenAI voice
Twilio phone integration
Lead capture
Appointment booking
24/7 availability

Primary CTA:

Get Started

Secondary CTA:

See Demo

Include animated visual showing:

Phone call incoming
AI answering
Conversation visualization
Lead captured
Appointment booked

CORE SECTIONS REQUIRED

Create these sections in order:

Hero

Trusted by modern businesses

The problem

The solution

How it works

Product capabilities

Use cases by industry

Why Jevus.ai is different

Integrations

ROI / cost savings

Social proof placeholder

Pricing preview

Final CTA

Footer

HOW IT WORKS SECTION

Explain architecture visually:

Step 1: Customer calls your business
Step 2: Twilio routes call
Step 3: OpenAI voice agent answers
Step 4: AI speaks naturally
Step 5: AI captures lead
Step 6: AI books appointment
Step 7: Data appears in dashboard

PRODUCT CAPABILITIES SECTION

Include:

• Human-like voice conversations
• Unlimited concurrent calls
• Lead qualification
• Appointment booking
• Call transfers
• Call summaries
• Transcripts
• Analytics dashboard
• Custom business knowledge

INTEGRATIONS SECTION

Show integrations with:

Twilio
OpenAI
Google Calendar
HubSpot
Salesforce
Zapier

Use integration logos or visual placeholders.

ROI SECTION

Explain financial benefits:

Cost of human receptionist vs Jevus.ai

Human receptionist: $3,000/month
Jevus.ai: starting at $99/month

Explain ROI clearly.

PRICING PREVIEW SECTION

Show pricing tiers:

Starter
Professional
Enterprise

Do not hardcode exact pricing logic, but show realistic SaaS pricing structure.

CTA SECTION

Strong conversion-focused CTA.

Examples:

Get Your AI Receptionist Today

Never Miss Another Call Again

FOOTER

Include:

Product
Pricing
About
Contact
Privacy
Terms

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Build as a modern SaaS frontend using:

React
Next.js
TailwindCSS

Mobile responsive
Fast loading
Production-ready
Clean architecture

ANIMATION REQUIREMENTS

Include subtle modern animations:

Hover states
Glow effects
Smooth transitions
Gradient animations

Professional only. No gimmicks.

BRAND VOICE COPY REQUIREMENTS

Copy must sound like a billion-dollar SaaS company.

Clear
Confident
Professional

No fluff
No hype language
No emojis

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS

Generate full production-ready landing page including:

Layout
Structure
Copy
Components
Visual hierarchy

Make it immediately deployable.

FINAL OBJECTIVE

This landing page must:

Build trust instantly
Communicate value clearly
Convert visitors into customers
Position Jevus.ai as the category leader in AI receptionist software

This should look and feel like a $100M+ SaaS company homepage.

PROMPT END

**Defining Scope & Specs**

I'm currently focused on defining the initial scope for the Jevus.ai sales landing page. Key considerations include the target audience and core value propositions. My confidence is high on securing a world-class senior frontend React engineer, but I need to investigate the level of expertise required for the Gemini API integration. This is an essential checklist item I'm tackling first.


**Confirming Design Parameters**

I've finalized the constraints and technical parameters for the Jevus.ai landing page. I've reconfirmed the use of React 18+, TypeScript, ESM, and Tailwind CSS, all via CDN. The landing page's file structure and the import strategy have also been nailed down. I'll adhere to the requirement for a responsive, mobile-first design with a persistent CTA. I'm satisfied that this checklist is comprehensive.


**Confirming Requirements Adherence**

I've completed a comprehensive checklist to ensure alignment with all specified constraints for the Jevus.ai sales landing page, gaining full confidence in meeting all requirements. The design philosophy will embrace a "Stripe-like" aesthetic, focusing on a dark theme with subtle gradients and grid-based layouts to achieve a clean and modern look. I've also clarified the need for SVGs and decided to integrate `framer-motion` and `react-icons`.


**Finalizing Requirement Validation**

I've completed a thorough checklist to confirm adherence to all specifications for the Jevus.ai sales landing page. I've reconfirmed my confidence, with a final score of 5/5, in delivering a functional and robust React application that fully meets all identified constraints. I'm focusing on "Stripe-like" design principles, which include a dark theme, subtle gradients, and grid-based layouts, and I'll include high-quality, abstract SVG icons. I also plan a dynamic hero section animation using `framer-motion` to simulate a call flow and illustrate the AI voice functionality. My component breakdown will include `Header`, `Hero`, `TrustedBy`, and `Problem` sections, among others.


**Validating All Constraints**

I've completed the constraint validation checklist with a perfect 5/5 confidence score. I've confirmed all requirements are met. The design direction is "Stripe-like," with a dark theme, subtle gradients, and grid-based layouts. I'll use high-quality SVGs for icons and plan to implement a dynamic hero section animation using `framer-motion` to illustrate the AI voice functionality. My component breakdown will include sections for the header, hero, and other core aspects. I plan to use SVGs for logos and visual elements. I've finalized component architecture and animation strategies with Framer Motion.


**Validating Final Design**

I'm now fully immersed in the design phase, and have revalidated my initial constraint checklist. I'm focusing on "Stripe-like" aesthetics with a dark theme and subtle gradients. The structure is set; I've got a comprehensive component breakdown, and animation strategies are planned. I'm leveraging `framer-motion` for animated visuals, including a hero section simulating a call flow.


**Defining Implementation Plan**

I've completed a comprehensive constraint checklist with 5/5 confidence. I'm satisfied and feel I can fully meet requirements. I've also finalized the implementation steps, starting with setup and theme. Next, I'll tackle the sticky header component with glassmorphism, then move onto the hero section. The hero will include headline, subheadline, CTA buttons, and the more complex animation sequence.


**Refining Technical Implementation**

I'm now refining the technical implementation details and component breakdown for the landing page. I've revalidated my confidence in the 5/5 score. I'm focusing on the setup steps, and I'll create `metadata.json`, `index.html`, `index.tsx`, and `App.tsx` first. The implementation starts with the layout and theming in `App.tsx`, and then it's followed by the creation of the sticky header with CTAs. Next I'll craft a hero section, and a full animation sequence. I'll continue by creating components for each section, for example, "Capabilities," and "How It Works". I'm planning to write custom SVG icons as React components.


**Validating Component Breakdown**

I'm now implementing the landing page, starting with the setup files and theming in `App.tsx`. The sticky header is next, featuring a glassmorphism effect. I'll then design the animated hero section, incorporating a phone, waveform, chat bubbles, and a calendar. After that, I'll create components like "Capabilities" and "How It Works". I am also planning on creating custom SVG icons as React components.
